text.en:
Today you learn small words that go with an action.
Wake up, Tom.
It means: stop sleeping.
Come back after the rehearsal.
It means: return later.

title.en: Get up, get on, get off

text.en:
Two words together make one idea.
Get up means leave your bed.
Get on means step into a bus or train.
Get off means step out of it.
I get up at seven.
She gets off at the next stop.

Turn on starts a machine. Turn off stops it.
Turn on the lamp.
Turn off the fan.
You can also say it this way:
Turn the oven on.
Learn the two words as one.
